# 🎨 Design Review

## Change and rationale
What player problem is being solved?

## Screens and components
List affected screens, components, themes and states.

## Visual evidence
Attach verified before/after screenshots at desktop and mobile widths.

## Design checks
- [ ] Hierarchy and readability.
- [ ] Light/dark themes.
- [ ] Contrast and focus visibility.
- [ ] Player identity is not color-only.
- [ ] Responsive layout and 200% zoom.
- [ ] Reduced motion.
- [ ] Empty, loading, error and terminal states.

## Decision
Reviewer, findings, issues, owner and approval date.
